panel_label.description: Panel letter as shown in the figure (e.g. A, B, C)

is_western_blot.description: Whether this panel shows western blot or immunoblot data

protein_or_piece_label.description: Protein name (or piece label) as shown on the blot

source_data_filename.description: Filename or path of the source data file containing this piece's raw data; empty string if none identified

source_data_status.description: Whether corresponding source data was found for this piece

source_data_matches_figure.description: Whether the source data piece matches the figure; use n/a when source_data_status is MISSING

western_blot_matching_result.description: 1-2 sentence summary: match or discrepancies for this piece

pieces.description: One entry per piece in this western blot panel; empty array if not a western blot
